title: The OWASP Top 10 applied to the test plan

videos.script: Every security talk starts with the same list. The OWASP Top 10. {{list}} It names ten kinds of failure, from broken access control to errors nobody planned for. {{ten}} It is not a checklist. Nobody can comply with it. It tells you where to look. {{where}} So in this lesson you turn it into a test plan for the box office and its account service. {{plan}} Each category becomes test cases you can fail. And every case says what holds it: a test, a scanner, or a person reading the design. {{held}} Half of the plan is already written. The tests of the last few lessons were security tests all along. {{half}} You probe the rest by hand, on your own machine. Headers, an error page, the log. {{probe}} And you find three things wrong. Each one gets written down, and two get a test that keeps them in view until they are fixed. {{findings}}
